essence: The third śakti-seed should always be conjoined with śiva.
Reciting the mantra thus formed yields all accomplishment.
The seed pervaded by bindu, nāda, and śikhā is supremely rare.
The declared five-syllabled vidyā is rare on earth.
The haṃsa-ending form may be used for purification of faults like sleep.
